title: 第9章 就算是系统也逃不过被林筱敲诈的命第10章 挂1 天生灵药者三师妹
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 系统这句话一出，林筱眼亮的都要变身成为奥特曼了。
系统这话什么意思，就比如说它选定了甲乙丙三个人，这三个人任意一人提升一级，她修为就提升三分之一级，如果甲乙丙三个人同时提升一级，她修为就无屏障直接提升一级！
我嘞个豆。
这外挂爽啊！
这要是系统选定上一百个人，她他妈还修炼什么啊，坐着不动都能当修真界霸主了！
但哪怕林筱内心已经快爽的起飞了，她表面还是一脸淡定，没有说话只是简单的嗯了一声。
看她反应，系统慌了。
不是，这都不心动？
系统接着道，“除此之外，系统还会发布一些任务，宿主完成任务也会有相应的奖励。”
怕林筱还不心动，系统又跟了一句，“奖励很丰盛哦。”
林筱还是一脸淡定，“先不说这些，来点实际的，绑定你我的新手礼包有什么？”
林筱这话把系统问懵了，“新手礼包？我没有新手礼包啊。”
“什么？”
林筱拔高音调，“人家系统都有就你没有，一看你就不是诚心要选我，不绑不绑。”
她摇头。
系统问，“宿主，你怎么知道还有其他系统？”
林筱眼一闪。
嗯？好像这小系统自爆了什么不得了的消息。
“我就是知道，我还知道它们的新手礼包都很丰盛。”
“真的吗？”
“你是系统我是系统，我还能骗你？”
系统一阵沉默，是哦，它才是系统，那这个人该不能骗它。
新手礼包，新手礼包是什么呢？程序上没有啊。
不行！
好不容易看对一个宿主，不能就这么放弃。
系统咬牙，“有有，我有新手礼包。”
林筱眼里快速划过一抹阴谋得逞的笑意，“哦？拿出来看看。”
系统翻出系统商城，本想随便拿点免费的东西给林筱，但想到林筱冷漠的样子，又怕自己选的东西太低级被林筱看不上，只好委屈巴巴用自己的钱在系统商城里买了点东西，包成礼包给林筱看。
林筱一看，好家伙，一枚四品丹药冰寒两转丹，一本玄级功法隐身诀，一张传送卷轴，还有一个逼我说真话灵药方。
功法等级，从上到下，依次为天地玄黄。
天级功法整个天衍宗都没有几本，地级功法也是极为宝贵，玄极功法就已经足以让人争破头抢了，一本稍差的拿出去卖都能卖几百块上品灵石。
发财了发财了！
这小系统太有钱了，随便整点新手礼包就这么多好东西，要是绑定上，她还不得爽疯了。
不行，不能犹豫了，再犹豫这小冤种……不，可爱的小系统被吓跑了就得不偿失了。
“行，看在礼包份上，勉强答应你了。”
content_en:
As soon as the system said these words, Lin Xiao was so excited that he almost transformed into Ultraman.
What does the system mean by this? For example, it selects three people, A, B, and C. If any one of these three people improves by one level, her cultivation level will increase by one-third. If A, B, and C increase by one level at the same time, her cultivation level will directly increase by one level without any barrier!
I'm a fool.
This plug-in is cool!
If the system selects a hundred people, what the hell is she still practicing? She can become the overlord of the cultivation world just by sitting still!
But even though Lin Xiao was feeling so happy in her heart, she still looked calm on the outside, saying nothing but simply saying yes.
Looking at her reaction, the system panicked.
No, this doesn’t bother you?
The system continued, "In addition, the system will also release some tasks, and the host will receive corresponding rewards for completing the tasks."
Afraid that Lin Xiao might not be tempted yet, the system added another sentence, "The rewards are very generous."
"Yeah."
Lin Xiao still looked calm, "Let's not talk about this for now, let's talk about something practical. What is the novice gift package that binds you and me?"
Lin Xiao's words confused the system, "Newbie gift pack? I don't have a novice gift pack."
"What?"
Lin Xiao raised his voice and said, "Everyone else has the system, but you don't. From the first glance, it seems that you don't sincerely want to choose me. I won't be tied to you."
She shook her head.
The system asked, "Host, how do you know there are other systems?"
Lin Xiao's eyes flashed.
Um? It seems like this little system has revealed some terrible news.
"I just know, and I also know that their novice gift packages are very generous."
"Really?"
"You are the system and I am the system, how can I still lie to you?"
The system was silent for a while, yes, it is the system, so this person should not cheat it.
Novice gift pack, what is the novice gift pack? Not in the program.
no!
It’s hard to find the right host, so you can’t just give up.
The system gritted its teeth and said, "Yes, I have a novice gift pack."
Lin Xiao's eyes quickly flashed with a smile of successful conspiracy, "Oh? Take it out and take a look."
The system pulled out the system mall and wanted to give Lin Xiao some free stuff. However, thinking of Lin Xiao's indifferent look and fearing that the things he chose were too low-level and Lin Xiao would not like them, he had no choice but to use his own money to buy something in the system mall and wrap it up as a gift bag for Lin Xiao.
Lin Xiao took a look, what a good guy, here is a fourth-grade elixir, Ice Cold Two-turn Pill, a mysterious-level invisibility technique, a teleportation scroll, and a magical prescription to force me to tell the truth.
The levels of the skills, from top to bottom, are Heaven and Earth Xuanhuang.
There are only a few copies of heaven-level skills in Tianyan Sect, and earth-level skills are extremely valuable. Xuanji skills are enough for people to fight over, and a lesser one can fetch hundreds of high-grade spiritual stones.
Get rich, get rich!
This little system is so rich, and there are so many good things in the novice gift package. If it is bound to it, she will be so happy.
No, I can't hesitate. If I hesitate any longer about this little bastard... No, if this cute little system is scared away, the gain will outweigh the loss.
"Okay, for the sake of the gift package, I reluctantly agree to it."
title_en: Chapter 9 Even the system cannot escape being blackmailed by Lin Xiao Chapter 10 Death 1 The third junior sister who is a natural elixir
